in_hebrew.name: Baptista
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Baptista הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word ‘baptizare’, meaning ‘to dip, immerse, or submerge’. This name is derived from the Greek word ‘baptizomai’, which also means ‘to immerse’. In Christian tradition, the name Baptista is given to those who administer the sacrament of baptism.

in_greek.name: Baptista
in_greek.long_meaning: Baptista είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Latin word ‘baptizare’, meaning ‘to dip, immerse, or submerge’. This name is derived from the Greek word ‘baptizomai’, which also means ‘to immerse’. In Christian tradition, the name Baptista is given to those who administer the sacrament of baptism.

in_latin.name: Baptista
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin verb 'baptizare', meaning 'to immerse, dip, or submerge'. Derived from 'baptis', meaning 'deep, immersed'. Baptism is a Christian sacrament symbolizing purification and regeneration.
